title: Three parameters, one average
prompt: Return the average of the three numbers, keeping decimals.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> float:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> float:
	return 0.0
hint: Add them up in brackets first, then divide by a number written with a decimal point.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> float:
	return (a + b + c) / 3.0
